WITH aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        product,
        AVG(revenue / NULLIF(units, 0)) AS unit_price,
        SUM(units) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY product
),
regression_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        REGR_SLOPE(total_quantity, unit_price) OVER () AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(total_quantity, unit_price) OVER () AS intercept
    FROM aggregated_sales
)
SELECT 
    product,
    unit_price,
    total_quantity,
    total_revenue,
    (slope * unit_price + intercept) AS trendline_value
FROM regression_calc
ORDER BY unit_price ASC

    SELECT 
        p.product_name,
        p.unit_price,
        SUM(s.units) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM 'products.csv' AS p
    JOIN 'sales.csv' AS s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_name, p.unit_price
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        REGR_SLOPE(total_quantity, unit_price) OVER () AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(total_quantity, unit_price) OVER () AS intercept
    FROM product_metrics
)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    unit_price,
    total_quantity,
    total_revenue,
    (slope * unit_price + intercept) AS trendline_y
FROM stats
